쿼리 작성: SELECT
  i.product_id,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS late_item_pct,
  COUNT(*) AS delivered_item_count
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-05-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-06-01'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.product_id;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  i.seller_id,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(o.order_approved_at) = DATE(i.shipping_limit_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_same_day,
  COUNT(*) AS item_count
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01'
GROUP BY i.seller_id;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  o.order_status,
  DAYOFWEEK(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS weekday,
  COUNT(i.order_item_id) AS total_items,
  SUM(i.price) AS total_product_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01'
GROUP BY o.order_status, DAYOFWEEK(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY o.order_status, weekday;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS year_month,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id
  FROM (
    SELECT order_id, seller_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id, seller_id
  ) x
  WHERE x.cnt >= 3
) t ON t.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY year_month;
